purpose: Canonical learner-facing epistemic-status vocabulary for Diderot. These labels describe epistemic authority, not pedagogical maturity or scientific truth.

axis_separation.epistemic_authority: Encoded here and rendered to learners.
axis_separation.pedagogical_maturity: Separate axis. Draft/reviewed/release state must not change epistemic authority by itself.

source-derived.label: source-derived
source-derived.description: Terminology or framing derived from cited source material. This does not by itself validate an MMALS transfer, analogy or project claim.

diderot-synthesis.label: Diderot synthesis
diderot-synthesis.description: A Diderot editorial or pedagogical synthesis that combines or reorganizes sources. It is not an upstream scientific result.

project-hypothesis.label: project hypothesis
project-hypothesis.description: A project-local proposition, working definition or refinement whose scope remains bounded by current evidence.

teaching-toy.label: teaching toy
teaching-toy.description: A deliberately constructed pedagogical example or simulation. It can illustrate a mechanism but is not outcome evidence.

qualified-research-evidence.label: qualified research evidence
qualified-research-evidence.description: A bounded local research result admitted only through the research → independent review → Diderot ingestion contract with a qualifying ACCEPT disposition.
